# gitea_release (Data Source)

Use this data source to retrieve details of a repository release in Gitea.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gitea_release" "example" {
  user = "my-org"
  repo = "my-repo"
  id   = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) Release ID
- `repo` (String) Repository name
- `user` (String) User or organization owner of the repository

### Read-Only

- `draft` (Boolean) Whether the release is a draft
- `note` (String) Release notes / body
- `prerelease` (Boolean) Whether the release is a pre-release
- `tag_name` (String) Tag name
- `target_commitish` (String) Target commitish
- `title` (String) Release title
